sources.title: SmolLM2-135M: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview SmolLM2-135M is a 135-million-parameter compact language model built for on-device inference and resource-constrained environments. Developed by HuggingFaceTB, it uses a Transformer decoder architecture trained on 2 trillion tokens across diverse datasets including FineWeb-Edu, DCLM, and The Stack.
